whoItsFor: Developers, security researchers, and reverse engineers who want their coding agent to inspect native binaries, apps, and runtime behavior, and explain or reproduce how a feature works.
useCases: Explain how an app feature works and build a similar one, citing the evidence
Inspect native binaries with pseudocode, assembly, strings, symbols, and call references
Analyze JavaScript/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, Android APKs, and websites
